items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: I’m working with a trio, a piano player by the name of Alex Leonard

ctx.x: You currently have opportunities to get out and perform?

I work every once in a while. I’m working with a trio, a piano player by the name of Alex Leonard, he sings and plays piano, he does both of them well — and Jay Leonhart is the bass player. So we just did a concert over here where I live, it was last week. It was the 27th of April. Normally the capacity is around 110, and they had to shut it down at 150 because they had a waiting list that could have reached 170. And it has to do with me,

because in this community I’m a really good tennis player and there’s like 90 families in here that play tennis, and everybody in that community knows me because I’m a good tennis player. They showed up. There’s an arts group that would show up anyway whether I was here or not, and you know the word got around that they couldn’t handle the volume. But so yes I do get out and play and it’s usually with these three guys but every once in a while — oh I did a job at a club called the Zinc Bar in Manhattan. It was…
